title: BotVersion - Data API
description: Represents a version of a bot or agent defined by a BotDefinition record. This object is available in API version 63.0 and later.

BotDefinitionId.description: This field relates a bot version to its parent BotDefinition record. This field is a relationship field.

CopilotPrimaryLanguage.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CopilotPrimaryLanguage.description: The primary language that the bot or agent communicates in.

CopilotSecondaryLanguages.description: A comma-separated list of additional languages that the bot or agent supports.

DeveloperName.description: The unique name for this object.

Status.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
Status.description: Indicates whether the bot version is active or inactive. Only one version for a related BotDefinition can be active at once. Possible values are: Active Inactive The default value is Inactive.

ToneType.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ToneType.description: Defines the tone of the bot. Possible values are: Casual— Formal— Neutral— The default value is Casual.

VersionNumber.description: The number for this version of the bot or agent.
